Curtis.description: Engineer; final decision authority. Only role that may resume Night Shift, lock subsystems, defer or mark ORIs unsupported.

Gilfoyle.description: Mission author / coordinator. Cannot verify fixes.

Anton.description: Implementer. FIXED moves an ORI only to CLAIMED_FIXED.

Warden.description: Independent auditor / acceptance. Only role that may move CLAIMED_FIXED -> WARDEN_VERIFIED.

Hunter.description: Print evidence gatherer. Cannot verify fixes.

subsystem_seed._note: Seed list only. Every subsystem starts in DEVELOPMENT; Switchboard makes no engineering assessment. Only an engineer decision packet can set LOCKED.
